meta.notes: A worldgen/feature tag gives one name to several worldgen/feature ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. Vanilla's #minecraft:can_spawn_from_bone_meal lists the flower features bone meal on grass can grow; a tag of your own such as #msm_examples:meadow_flowers is for grouping and reuse.
